sources.title_original: US mulling ban on key Chinese networking tech in data center component crackdown — White House wants to impose restrictions in 2026, China says it will respond if necessary
sources.summary: Sources say that the FCC is drafting a ban on optical transceivers for data centers. These components, which convert electrical signals into light signals, are said to pose a risk as they can be used to steal data, install malware, or disrupt data center operations in the U.S.
sources.summary_zh: 消息人士称，FCC 正在起草一项数据中心光收发器禁令。这些将电信号转换为光信号的组件据说会带来风险，因为它们可用于窃取数据、安装恶意软件或扰乱美国数据中心的运营。

stories.title: Texas slams on the breaks for 1,800 data centers, power grid requirements are five times higher than peak record demand — 474 gigawatts of power requests are now subject to new moratorium

sources.title: Texas slams on the breaks for 1,800 data centers, power grid requirements are five times higher than peak record demand — 474 gigawatts of power requests are now subject to new moratorium
sources.title_en: Texas slams on the breaks for 1,800 data centers, power grid requirements are five times higher than peak record demand — 474 gigawatts of power requests are now subject to new moratorium
sources.title_original: Texas slams on the breaks for 1,800 data centers, power grid requirements are five times higher than peak record demand — 474 gigawatts of power requests are now subject to new moratorium
sources.summary: Gov. Greg Abbott (R) instructed PUCT and ERCOT to pause all data center applications until they complete an audit on all the information that data center developers must submit. The move reportedly came after PUCT asked 377 data center operators to submit water and power use, of which only 28 complied.
sources.summary_zh: 州长 Greg Abbott（共和党）指示 PUCT 和 ERCOT 暂停所有数据中心应用程序，直到完成对数据中心开发人员必须提交的所有信息的审核。据报道，此举是在 PUCT 要求 377 家数据中心运营商提交水和电力使用情况后做出的，其中只有 28 家遵守了规定。
